reforms.description: The budget for science and technology was centralised in the Council for Science, Technology and Innovation to promote effective R&D and stimulate innovation through science and technology. The 5th Science and Technology Basic Plan aims at achieving more effective use of government research grants by boosting the share of public research funds for universities that is allocated competitively. Additionally, the Cabinet Office Council for Science, Technology and Innovation formulated the National Energy and Environment Strategy for Technological Innovation towards 2050, focusing on promoting the innovation and diffusion of energy-saving and abatement technologies.
reforms.component_name: Centralisation of Science and Technology Budget
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: The reforms aim to enhance the effectiveness of R&D funding and promote innovation, which is expected to raise productivity and efficiency in the public research sector.
reforms.status_evidence: The budget reforms have been implemented as part of the ongoing strategy for science and technology.
reforms.importance_rationale: The centralisation of the budget and the strategic planning represent a significant structural change in how R&D is funded and managed.
reforms.source_quote: The budget for science and technology, which had been managed by a number of ministries, was centralised in the Council for Science, Technology and Innovation to promote effective R&D.

reforms.description: The tax system for business angels was made more user-friendly, and measures to promote crowdfunding were launched to create a venture ecosystem. Additionally, Japan Finance Corporation is expanding the targets of loan programmes for start-ups in FY 2017, providing second opportunities for entrepreneurs.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: These reforms aim to enhance access to funding for startups, which is expected to foster innovation and entrepreneurship, thereby supporting economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The reforms have been successfully implemented to support the startup ecosystem.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, these reforms are part of a broader effort to enhance the startup ecosystem rather than a standalone major reform.
reforms.source_quote: Japan Finance Corporation is expanding the targets of loan programmes for start-ups in FY 2017, providing second opportunities for entrepreneurs.

reforms.description: Japan is implementing reforms to strengthen market forces in SME financing by requiring banks to provide loans to SMEs without personal guarantees and reducing the coverage of the largest guarantee scheme.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: These reforms aim to improve access to financing for SMEs, which can enhance their ability to innovate and grow, contributing positively to the economy.
reforms.status_evidence: The reforms have been implemented to enhance SME financing.
reforms.importance_rationale: The reforms represent a significant change in SME financing practices, although they are not as comprehensive as other major reforms.
reforms.source_quote: The government is planning to reform the guarantee system: i) banks applying for credit guarantees will have to supply loans to SMEs without credit guarantees; and ii) the largest 100% guarantee scheme will lower its rate to 80%.

reforms.description: The government introduced a Stewardship Code for institutional investors and a Corporate Governance Code for publicly-listed companies to enhance corporate governance and improve capital allocation.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Improved corporate governance is expected to lead to better capital allocation, which can enhance innovation and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The governance reforms have been successfully implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: While important, these reforms are part of a broader governance framework rather than a standalone major reform.
reforms.source_quote: The government introduced a Stewardship Code for institutional investors in 2014 and a Corporate Governance Code for publicly-listed companies in 2015.

reforms.description: Japan has established the SME Training Institute, which offers seminars for owners and managers of SMEs, focusing on financial education to help them utilize market-based financing instruments beyond traditional bank lending.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: By enhancing financial education for SME owners and managers, the initiative aims to improve their ability to access and utilize financing, thereby supporting innovation and growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The SME Training Institute has been established and is operational.
reforms.importance_rationale: This initiative is significant for improving human capital in SMEs but is not a major reform on its own.
reforms.source_quote: Japan has established the SME Training Institute, which offers seminars for owners and managers of SMEs.

reforms.description: The government has launched educational programmes such as the Enhancing Development of Global Entrepreneur Program aimed at university and graduate students to foster entrepreneurial skills.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: These educational programmes aim to develop entrepreneurial skills among students, which can lead to increased innovation and economic activity.
reforms.status_evidence: The government has announced the launch of these educational programmes.
reforms.importance_rationale: While important for fostering skills, these initiatives are part of a broader educational strategy rather than a standalone major reform.
reforms.source_quote: The government has launched educational programmes such as the Enhancing Development of Global Entrepreneur Program.

reforms.description: The government launched the Program for an Open Innovation Platform with Enterprises, Research Institutes and Academia (OPERA) to promote R&D collaboration between universities and firms, particularly at the pre-competitive stage of development.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This program aims to enhance collaboration between academia and industry, facilitating knowledge transfer and innovation, which can positively impact economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The OPERA program has been successfully launched and is operational.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant for promoting collaboration, this initiative is part of a broader strategy rather than a major reform.
reforms.source_quote: In 2016, the government launched the Program on Open Innovation Platform with Enterprises, Research Institute and Academia (OPERA) to foster university-industry partnerships, funded by companies and the government.

reforms.description: Japan launched a four-year plan to digitalise the educational environment, investing 671 billion yen to equip schools with computers, electronic blackboards, and education software.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Investing in educational digitalisation is expected to enhance learning outcomes and prepare students for a technology-driven economy, supporting long-term economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The digitalisation plan has been successfully launched and is in progress.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, this initiative is part of a broader educational strategy rather than a standalone major reform.
reforms.source_quote: In 2014, Japan launched a four-year plan, totalling 671 billion yen (USD 5.9 billion) to equip schools with more computers (for both teachers and students), electronic blackboards, wireless LANs and education software.

reforms.description: The government aims to increase IT literacy across all age groups, particularly focusing on older adults who have relatively poor IT skills.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: Improving IT literacy is essential for enabling individuals to participate in a digital economy, which can enhance overall productivity and economic growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The government has announced plans to increase IT literacy.
reforms.importance_rationale: While important for enhancing skills, this initiative is part of a broader strategy rather than a standalone major reform.
reforms.source_quote: The government stated that it will consider policies to develop human resources to drive IT utilisation at private-sector companies.
